By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

* Strong communication skills, including the ability to communicate the data management subject matter to a non-technical/unfamiliar internal customer.

* An aptitude for problem solving and strategic thinking and ensuring high quality data output with strong quality assurance
* Ability to synthesize complex information into clear and actionable insights
* Proven ability to work effectively across all levels of stakeholders and diverse functions
* Solid understanding of pharmaceutical development, manufacturing, supply chain and marketing functions
* Demonstrated leadership and management in driving innovation and automation leveraging advanced statistical and analytical techniques
* Effectively collaborate across differing levels of management, functions and role
* Strong decision-making skills, identifying key issues, developing solutions and gaining commitment
* Experience working with Analytics team like Field reporting, Field Deployment and Incentive compensation is a Plus.

Certainly. Here's a polished and hiring-manager-ready
**Data Modeler Job Description**
that would fit a modern Data & Analytics team supporting Data Engineering, Governance, Analytics, and Product organizations.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a highly skilled
**Data Modeler**
to design, develop, and maintain enterprise-wide data models that support reporting, analytics, operational systems, data products, and AI-driven initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will work closely with Data Engineering, Product Management, Data Governance, Analytics, Architecture, and Business teams to ensure data is structured, scalable, governed, and aligned with business objectives. This role is critical in building trusted, reusable, and high-quality data assets across the organization.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Data Modeling & Design
  
  

* Design and maintain conceptual, logical, and physical data models for enterprise data platforms.
* Develop scalable data structures to support analytics, reporting, operational applications, and data products.
* Define entities, attributes, relationships, hierarchies, and business rules.
* Create dimensional, relational, and canonical data models based on business requirements.
* Ensure data models support current and future business needs while maintaining consistency across domains.

Data Architecture & Engineering Collaboration
  
  

* Partner with Data Engineering teams to implement data models across data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse architectures.
* Support design and optimization of enterprise data platforms and data pipelines.
* Translate business requirements into technical data structures and schemas.
* Collaborate with solution architects to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards.
* Drive adoption of best practices in data modeling and database design.

Product & Analytics Partnership
  
  

* Work closely with Product Managers to understand business requirements and define data structures that support product capabilities.
* Collaborate with Analytics teams to enable reporting, dashboards, KPIs, and self-service analytics.
* Support the design of reusable and governed data products that can be leveraged across multiple business functions.
* Participate in discovery sessions and solution design workshops with business stakeholders.

Data Governance & Quality
  
  

* Partner with Data Governance teams to establish and enforce data standards, naming conventions, and modeling guidelines.
* Support data lineage, metadata management, and master data initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
* Proactively identify and address data quality and consistency issues.
* Promote data stewardship and governance practices across the organization.

Documentation & Standards
  
  

* Maintain comprehensive documentation for data models, definitions, and business rules.
* Create and manage data dictionaries, metadata repositories, and lineage documentation.
* Conduct model reviews and recommend improvements.
* Establish and maintain enterprise data modeling standards and best practices.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Act as a trusted advisor on data structures and information architecture.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Project Management, Governance, and Analytics teams to deliver enterprise data solutions.
* Communicate data design decisions and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
* Support project teams in assessing the impact of business and system changes on data assets.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, or related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Data Warehousing roles.
* Strong expertise in conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling techniques.
* Experience designing relational and dimensional data models.
* Strong understanding of data warehousing and modern data platform architectures.
* Advanced SQL skills and understanding of database design principles.
* Experience working with large-scale enterprise data environments.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS Iceberg, Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, or similar cloud data platforms.
* Experience using data modeling tools such as Erwin, ER/Studio, PowerDesigner, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of Data Vault, Kimball, and dimensional modeling methodologies.
* Experience supporting Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or other BI platforms.
* Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM), Metadata Management, and Data Governance frameworks.
* Experience within Payments, Financial Services, FinTech, Risk, or Fraud domains.
* Exposure to AI/ML data requirements and feature engineering concepts.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Data Modeling (Conceptual, Logical, Physical)
* Dimensional Modeling
* Data Warehousing
* SQL
* Data Architecture
* Metadata Management
* Data Governance
* Master Data Management
* ETL/ELT Concepts
* Cloud Data Platforms
* Database Performance Optimization
* Data Quality Frameworks

Key Competencies
  
  

* Strong Business Acumen
* Stakeholder Management
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration & Teamwork
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Documentation Excellence
* Strategic Thinking
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

Success Measures
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Will**

* Deliver scalable and reusable enterprise data models.
* Improve data consistency, usability, and quality across platforms.
* Enable faster delivery of analytics and reporting solutions.
* Support governance, compliance, and data stewardship initiatives.
* Reduce data redundancy and improve enterprise-wide data standardization.
* Drive adoption of trusted, well-documented, and governed data assets across the organization.

**Ideal Candidate:**
A collaborative data professional who can bridge business requirements and technical implementation while working effectively with Engineering, Product, Analytics, Data Governance, and Architecture teams to build a trusted data foundation for the enterprise.

**Title And Summary**
 Senior Data Engineer\-4
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.

**Overview**
 Mastercard is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, India. This is an experienced individual\-contributor role that owns end\-to\-end pipeline delivery and mentors peers. It will appeal to you if you combine deep technical expertise with the ability to independently deliver complex data solutions and raise the bar for the engineers around you.
   

  

 You will bring cutting edge software and full stack development skills with advanced knowledge of cloud and data lake experience while working with massive data volumes. Our teams are small, agile, and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace, and you will work across functional teams within Mastercard to deliver on our cloud strategy while keeping our systems resilient, responsive, and maintainable on cloud.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of complex batch and real\-time data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Python, and PySpark.
   

  

 Drive dbt\-based transformation architecture with rigorous Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and modular design.
   

  

 Design and own CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, and champion DataOps practices across the team.
   

  

 Administer and optimize Databricks objects and the platform using Databricks Asset Bundles, managing performance, access, and cost.
   

  

 Establish data observability frameworks covering quality, freshness, lineage, and anomaly detection.
   

  

 Lead the design of real\-time data streaming pipelines (e.g., using Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
   

  

 Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
   

  

 Partner with stakeholders on requirements, delivery planning, and technical trade\-offs.
   

  

 Plan and execute deployments, migrations, and upgrades with minimal disruption to operations.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field (Master's a plus).
   

  

 5\+ years of data engineering experience.
   

  

 Deep hands\-on experience with Databricks (including administration), Spark, and Python.
   

  

 Strong background in PySpark and distributed data processing.
   

  

 Proven track record using dbt for robust, testable transformation workflows following TDD.
   

  

 Familiarity with Databricks Asset Bundles for object deployment and version control.
   

  

 Strong CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) and DataOps expertise.
   

  

 Experience with real\-time data processing and streaming pipelines.
   

  

 Expert SQL development and strong cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
   

  

 Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and leading technical delivery.
   

  

 Ideally you have experience in banking, e\-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises\-based architectures. In addition, you have a post\-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

For more information, visit www.blend360\.com.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Power BI Migration Engineer to support an enterprise\-scale Tableau to Power BI migration initiative.
   

  





 The role will be primarily focused on Power BI (approximately 70%), with Tableau (approximately 25%) involvement. The ideal candidate will have deep hands\-on expertise in Power BI, advanced DAX, data modeling, Microsoft Fabric, Python, Databricks, APIs, and performance optimization, along with strong working knowledge of Tableau.
   

  





 You will be responsible for analyzing existing Tableau dashboards, reports, calculations, data sources, and business logic and translating them into scalable, high\-performance Power BI solutions. The role requires someone who can independently troubleshoot complex BI challenges, make technical decisions, and establish migration and development best practices.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




 1\. Tableau to Power BI Migration
   

  




* Analyze existing Tableau dashboards, workbooks, data sources, calculations, filters, parameters, LOD expressions, and business logic.
* Design and implement equivalent or improved solutions in Power BI.
* Translate Tableau calculations, LOD expressions, table calculations, parameters, and sets into appropriate Power BI/DAX implementations.
* Assess Tableau dashboards and determine the appropriate Power BI architecture and visualization approach.
* Identify gaps or functional differences between Tableau and Power BI and develop suitable solutions.
* Perform migration validation, including data accuracy, calculations, filters, visualizations, performance, and business functionality.
* Support migration of enterprise\-scale Tableau reporting environments to Power BI.
* Help establish reusable migration patterns, frameworks, standards, and best practices.



 2\. Power BI Design \& Development
   

  




* Design and develop enterprise\-grade Power BI reports and semantic models.
* Build scalable star\-schema data models and implement advanced DAX.
* Develop complex DAX solutions including:
	+ Time intelligence
	+ Calculation groups
	+ Field parameters
	+ Dynamic formatting
	+ Complex measures and business calculations
* Develop intuitive dashboards with strong UX, drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips, and custom visuals.
* Use Power Query/M and SQL for data preparation and transformation.
* Select appropriate Power BI storage modes including Import, DirectQuery, and Composite models.
* Develop solutions that meet requirements for scalability, performance, security, and maintainability.



 3\. Microsoft Fabric \& Data Engineering
   

  




* Develop and support Power BI solutions leveraging Microsoft Fabric.
* Work with Fabric components including:
	+ OneLake
	+ Lakehouse
	+ Warehouse
	+ Data Pipelines
	+ Dataflows Gen2
	+ Notebooks
	+ Direct Lake
* Integrate Power BI with Databricks and other enterprise data platforms.
* Work with Python/PySpark for data preparation, automation, and analytics use cases.
* Collaborate with data engineering teams to optimize upstream data structures for BI consumption.
* Understand Fabric capacity, workspace architecture, Git integration, and deployment practices.



 4\. Performance Optimization
   

  




* Diagnose and resolve performance issues across Power BI reports and semantic models.
* Optimize DAX, data models, queries, relationships, calculations, and visualizations.
* Use tools such as:
	+ DAX Studio
	+ Tabular Editor
	+ VertiPaq Analyzer
	+ Power BI Performance Analyzer
* Implement incremental refresh, aggregations, partitioning, and appropriate storage strategies.
* Optimize migrated reports to ensure performance is equal to or better than the legacy Tableau implementation.



 5\. APIs \& Automation
   

  




* Develop automation using Power BI REST APIs and/or PowerShell.
* Work with Tableau REST/Metadata APIs where required during the migration.
* Use Python for automation, migration support, data processing, or API integrations.
* Automate repetitive deployment, validation, reporting, or administrative activities where appropriate.
* Experience with Power BI Embedded and paginated reports is desirable.



 6\. Security, Governance \& Administration
   

  




* Implement Power BI security including Row\-Level Security (RLS) and Object\-Level Security (OLS).
* Establish appropriate workspace and access\-control strategies.
* Manage Power BI Service capabilities including:
	+ Workspaces
	+ Apps
	+ Gateways
	+ Scheduled refresh
	+ Deployment pipelines
	+ Sensitivity labels
	+ Lineage
	+ Endorsement
* Support Power BI development standards, governance, and lifecycle management.
* Work with PBIP/TMDL, source control, and deployment processes where applicable.



 7\. Tableau Responsibilities
   

  




* Work with existing Tableau environments to understand the architecture and business logic being migrated.
* Review Tableau Desktop workbooks, dashboards, data sources, calculations, and extracts.
* Understand advanced Tableau concepts including:
	+ LOD expressions
	+ Table calculations
	+ Parameters
	+ Set actions
	+ Relationships/joins/blends
	+ Hyper extracts
* Support Tableau Server/Tableau Cloud analysis during migration.
* Understand Tableau performance optimization and security concepts.
* Use Tableau REST/Metadata APIs or related tools when required for migration activities.



 8\. Technical Leadership \& Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Act as a technical SME for Power BI migration initiatives.
* Provide technical guidance to BI developers and data teams.
* Review Power BI solutions and migrated dashboards for quality, performance, and adherence to standards.
* Troubleshoot complex migration and reporting issues.
* Work closely with business stakeholders to understand existing Tableau functionality and translate requirements into Power BI solutions.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor developers and contribute to BI development standards and best practices.


**Qualifications**

**Must Have:**



* 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Power BI / enterprise BI analytics.
* Advanced Power BI expertise.
* Expert\-level DAX and semantic/data modeling skills.
* Strong experience with Power Query/M and SQL.
* Strong experience with Microsoft Fabric.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks.
* Strong Python experience.
* Experience working with APIs, particularly Power BI REST APIs and/or Tableau APIs.
* Strong understanding of Power BI performance optimization.
* Experience with Power BI Service, workspaces, security, refresh, deployment, and governance.
* Experience with RLS/OLS.
* Experience with advanced Power BI development and enterprise\-scale semantic models.
* Strong understanding of Tableau, including dashboards, calculations, data sources, and performance.
* Hands\-on experience with Tableau to Power BI migration or similar BI platform migration.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.

* **Competitive Salary:**

title: Engineer (MIS) - Solar O&M
description:
****JOB DESCRIPTION****
**Position: Junior Engineer/Engineer MIS – Solar O\&M**
**Department:** 
 Renewable Energy – Solar O\&M
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Function:** 
 Solar Operations \& Maintenance
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Manager – Solar O\&M / Head– Solar O\&M
   

  

**Experience:** 
 1\-6 Year
   

  

**Education:** 
 B.Tech/Diploma\-Electrical
   

  

* Purpose of the Role


 To support the Head Office Solar O\&M team through effective
 **MIS, coordination, tracking, follow\-up, reporting and closure of O\&M\-related activities** 
 across multiple solar projects, ensuring accurate, timely and reliable information is available for management review and decision\-making.
   

  

 The role will act as the
 **central HO coordination point for PGT, HOTO, O\&M readiness, action trackers, vendor bills and pending O\&M activities** 
 , working closely with site, project and support\-function teams to drive timely closure. This is primarily an HO\-based coordination and reporting position and not a site execution role.
   

  

* Key Roles \& Responsibilities


**2\.1 PGT \& HOTO Coordination**
* Track and follow up on Plant Guarantee Test (PGT) activities across all projects.
* Maintain project\-wise PGT status trackers covering schedule, test status, observations, reports and closure.
* Coordinate with site and project teams for timely completion and closure of PGT activities and related documentation.
* Follow up on Handover \& Takeover (HOTO) activities, including:
* Pending punch points
* As\-built drawings, test certificates and technical documentation
* Spares, tools, tackles and materials handover
* OEM manuals, warranties and other handover requirements
* Maintain project\-wise HOTO and punch\-point status trackers with responsibility, target date and closure status.
* Highlight delays and escalate long\-pending PGT/HOTO issues to the HO O\&M team.


**2\.2 MIS \& Dashboard Management**
* Prepare, update and circulate daily, weekly and monthly Solar O\&M MIS reports.
* Maintain O\&M dashboards covering:
* PGT and HOTO status
* O\&M readiness status
* Manpower deployment
* Generation, availability and PR/CUF data
* Pending activities and open action points
* Other key O\&M KPIs as defined by management
* Ensure timely collection of data from project/site teams as per defined reporting formats and timelines.
* Verify, validate and consolidate data before reporting, and highlight gaps or inconsistencies to the concerned teams.
* Prepare management\-level summaries, status reports and review inputs as required.


**2\.3 Tracker Preparation \& Follow\-up**
* Prepare and circulate project\-wise action trackers after review meetings and discussions.
* Track pending activities, responsible persons, target dates and closure status.
* Regularly follow up with respective stakeholders until closure of each action point.
* Publish periodic ageing analysis of open points and highlight overdue items.
* Escalate critical delays and long\-pending issues to the HO O\&M team as per the escalation matrix.


**2\.4 Stakeholder Coordination**
* Coordinate with site teams, project teams, EPC teams, O\&M vendors, contractors, SCM, Commercial, Finance, HR, QA/QC and other internal/external stakeholders.
* Follow up on pending actions and ensure timely responses and closures.
* Schedule review meetings, prepare agendas and circulate Minutes of Meeting (MOM) with clear action points.
* Maintain proper communication records, correspondence and action\-point history.


**2\.5 Bills \& Commercial Follow\-up**
* Coordinate and follow up on O\&M/vendor bills, supporting documents, work\-completion certifications, approvals and payment status.
* Track pending bills and coordinate with Commercial/Finance and project teams for timely processing.
* Maintain a project\-wise bill status tracker with submission, certification, approval and payment details.
* Highlight bills pending beyond defined timelines and support resolution of documentation gaps.


**2\.6 O\&M Activity Monitoring**
* Follow up on planned and pending O\&M activities across projects.
* Monitor status of:
* Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedule compliance
* Breakdown\-related actions and restoration status
* RCA and CAPA closure for major failures/incidents
* Major pending works
* Spares and material requirements
* Other O\&M deliverables and statutory/audit observations
* Coordinate with site teams for timely completion and closure of activities.
* Track incident and equipment failure reports received from sites and follow up on submission of RCA/CAPA reports as per the approved format.


**2\.7 Reporting \& Documentation**
* Maintain proper records of project\-wise reports, trackers, MOMs, correspondence, approvals and O\&M documentation.
* Maintain a structured and version\-controlled central repository of O\&M data and documents at HO.
* Prepare presentations, review reports and management updates whenever required.
* Support the Solar O\&M team in data analysis, trend analysis and preparation of management reports.
* Ensure records are complete, updated and available for internal reviews and audits.


**2\.8 Process Standardization \& Continuous Improvement**
* Develop and maintain standard MIS formats, templates and tracker structures for uniform reporting across projects.
* Identify opportunities to improve data quality, reporting timelines and follow\-up effectiveness.
* Support digitalization and automation of MIS reports and dashboards.
* Adhere to company policies, data confidentiality and IMS/quality requirements.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* Timely Submission of MIS Reports \& Dashboards
* Accuracy \& Completeness of Reported Data
* PGT Status Tracking \& Closure Follow\-up
* HOTO / Punch\-Point Closure Tracking
* Action Tracker Closure (%) \& Ageing of Open Points
* Pending Vendor Bill Ageing
* PM Compliance \& Pending Activity Follow\-up
* RCA / CAPA Report Submission Follow\-up
* Timely Escalation of Critical Issues
* Timely Circulation of MOMs \& Management Updates
* Stakeholder Responsiveness \& Satisfaction
* Authority


**The Position Shall Have Authority To:**
* Seek data, reports and status updates from site, project and vendor teams as per defined formats and timelines.
* Circulate MIS reports, trackers and MOMs to relevant stakeholders.
* Follow up directly with internal teams, vendors and contractors on pending actions.
* Escalate delays, data gaps and long\-pending issues to the Manager – Solar O\&M / Head – Solar O\&M.
* Recommend improvements to reporting formats, trackers and coordination processes.
* Internal Coordination


**The Role Will Coordinate With:**
* Manager / Head – Solar O\&M
* Site O\&M Teams
* Project Execution / EPC Teams
* Central Monitoring / SCADA Team
* Procurement / SCM
* Commercial / Contracts Team
* Finance
* HR
* QA/QC
* HSE
* IT / Digital Teams
* External Coordination


**The Role Will Coordinate With:**

title: Applied Scientist I, Worldwide Returns & Recommerce - Science
description:
**Description**
 Welcome to the Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.
   

  

 WWR\&R is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. Our goal is to achieve the three zeroes: zero cost of returns, zero waste, and zero defects. We do this by developing products and driving truly innovative operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon – Returns \& ReCommerce.
   

  

 Amazon WWR\&R is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop highly respected product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.
   

  

 You will help create everything from customer\-facing and vendor\-facing websites to the internal software and tools behind the reverse\-logistics process. You can develop scalable, high\-availability solutions to solve complex and broad business problems.
   

  

 We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.
   

  

 Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WWR\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Design, develop, and evaluate highly innovative models for Natural Language Programming (NLP), Large Language Model (LLM), or Large Computer Vision Models.
* Use SQL to query and analyze the data.
* Use Python, Jupyter notebook, and Pytorch to train/test/deploy ML models.
* Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems.
* Research and implement novel machine learning and statistical approaches.
* Mentor interns.
* Work closely with data \& software engineering teams to build model implementations and integrate successful models and algorithms in production systems at very large scale.


**About The Team**
 When a customer returns a package to Amazon, the request and package will be passed through our WWRR machine learning (ML) systems so that we could improve the customer experience, identify return root cause, optimize re\-use, and evaluate the returned package. Our problems touch multiple modalities spanning from: textual, categorical, image, to speech data.
   

  

 We operate at large scale and rely on state\-of\-the\-art modeling techniques to power our ML models: XGBoost, BERT, Vision Transformers, Large Language Models.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience programming in Java, C\+\+, Python or related language
* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self\-developed code
* Have publications at top\-tier peer\-reviewed conferences or journals

**Plan \& Review**

**Dependency Management**

* Define clear acceptance criteria so the team knows when a requirement is complete and ready for release, safeguarding quality and fitness\-for\-purpose from the user’s perspective.



**Continuous Improvement** 



* Actively seek feedback from stakeholders, squad members, and end\-users to identify improvement opportunities, and foster adherence to product and agile best practices.
* Use adoption, quality, and performance signals to drive simplification and continuous improvement of the workflow product.



**Workflow** 
**Governance**

**Adoption \& Change Management** 



* Drive adoption of workflow capabilities through stakeholder engagement, training needs identification, communications, and feedback management.

**Automation \& Innovation** 



* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate workflow activities through AI, workflow intelligence, low\-code platforms, RPA, and business rules automation.

title: Senior Data Engineer-1
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Data Engineer\-1
   

  

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.
   

  

**Overview**
 Mastercard is seeking a Senior Data Engineer to join our team in Hyderabad, India. This is an experienced individual\-contributor role that owns end\-to\-end pipeline delivery and mentors peers. It will appeal to you if you combine deep technical expertise with the ability to independently deliver complex data solutions and raise the bar for the engineers around you.
   

  

 You will bring cutting edge software and full stack development skills with advanced knowledge of cloud and data lake experience while working with massive data volumes. Our teams are small, agile, and focused on the needs of the high growth fintech marketplace, and you will work across functional teams within Mastercard to deliver on our cloud strategy while keeping our systems resilient, responsive, and maintainable on cloud.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end design, development, and delivery of complex batch and real\-time data pipelines using Databricks, Spark, Python, and PySpark.
   

  

 Drive dbt\-based transformation architecture with rigorous Test\-Driven Development (TDD) and modular design.
   

  

 Design and own CI/CD pipelines using GitLab and Jenkins, and champion DataOps practices across the team.
   

  

 Administer and optimize Databricks objects and the platform using Databricks Asset Bundles, managing performance, access, and cost.
   

  

 Establish data observability frameworks covering quality, freshness, lineage, and anomaly detection.
   

  

 Lead the design of real\-time data streaming pipelines (e.g., using Kafka, Spark Structured Streaming).
   

  

 Mentor junior and mid\-level engineers, and lead code and design reviews.
   

  

 Partner with stakeholders on requirements, delivery planning, and technical trade\-offs.
   

  

 Plan and execute deployments, migrations, and upgrades with minimal disruption to operations.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field (Master's a plus).
   

  

 5\+ years of data engineering experience.
   

  

 Deep hands\-on experience with Databricks (including administration), Spark, and Python.
   

  

 Strong background in PySpark and distributed data processing.
   

  

 Proven track record using dbt for robust, testable transformation workflows following TDD.
   

  

 Familiarity with Databricks Asset Bundles for object deployment and version control.
   

  

 Strong CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) and DataOps expertise.
   

  

 Experience with real\-time data processing and streaming pipelines.
   

  

 Expert SQL development and strong cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
   

  

 Demonstrated experience mentoring engineers and leading technical delivery.
   

  

 Ideally you have experience in banking, e\-commerce, credit cards or payment processing and exposure to both SaaS and premises\-based architectures. In addition, you have a post\-secondary degree in computer science, mathematics, or quantitative science.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
**Data Engineer** 




**Hyderabad, Telangana, India \| Hybrid** 




**About AssetMark** 




 AssetMark is a leading wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial advisors. AssetMark's mission is to enable financial advisors to make a profound difference in the lives of their clients. Over 10,000 advisors partner with AssetMark for our investment offerings, innovative technology, advanced services, and expertise, which they use to delight their clients and grow their businesses. We are an integrated team of technologists, investment professionals, and operations experts working to help our clients stay at the pioneering front of wealth management.
 



**The Opportunity** 




 We are seeking a talented Data Engineer to join our data engineering team in Hyderabad. This position offers an exceptional opportunity to accelerate your career in a collaborative environment while building and operating trusted data platform capabilities, ingestion pipelines, integrations, and data feeds that support AssetMark's wealth management platform.
 



 As a Data Engineer, you'll work alongside experienced engineers who will mentor you while you contribute to mission\-critical solutions across our Azure and Snowflake data stack. You'll help onboard and move data from diverse internal and external sources, support MDS tools and related services, and improve data reliability, governance, security, and observability. You will gain experience with AssetMark's modern data ecosystem, including Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Monte Carlo, Immuta, and Atlan, while developing the technical expertise and business knowledge to take on increasingly complex responsibilities.
 



 As part of AssetMark's Hyderabad Technology Center, our India global capability center (GCC), this role is based in Hyderabad and follows a hybrid work model. You will collaborate with colleagues across India and the United States, with reasonable working\-hour overlap when needed for team ceremonies, planning, production support, and delivery.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Data Platform Engineering:** 
 Design, build, test, and maintain scalable, reliable, and fault\-tolerant ETL/ELT pipelines and reusable platform components across Azure and Snowflake.
* **Data Ingestion \& Source Onboarding:** 
 Integrate complex financial data from internal systems, third\-party providers, databases, APIs, and files; support batch and near\-real\-time ingestion patterns where appropriate.
* **Integrations, Data Feeds \& MDS Support:** 
 Develop and operate inbound and outbound integrations and data feeds, support MDS tools and dependencies, troubleshoot production issues, and help ensure reliable delivery to downstream consumers.
* **Data Reliability \& Operations:** 
 Monitor pipeline health, freshness, volume, schema changes, and failures; respond to incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, and improve performance, resilience, recoverability, and cost efficiency.
* **Data Quality, Governance \& Security:** 
 Implement automated validations, documentation, lineage, cataloging, access controls, encryption, and sensitive\-data protections in accordance with financial\-industry governance and security standards.
* **Engineering Practices:** 
 Use Python, SQL, and fit\-for\-purpose data tools to deliver maintainable solutions; follow Git\-based workflows, code reviews, testing, automated deployment, and CI/CD standards using platforms such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* **Business \& Technical Collaboration:** 
 Partner with product managers, business users, operations teams, data stewards, analysts, and engineers to understand processes, clarify requirements, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
* **Global Delivery \& Continuous Improvement:** 
 Participate actively in agile ceremonies, retrospectives, documentation, and knowledge sharing across the GCC and U.S. teams, and responsibly use AI\-assisted engineering methods to improve development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting.



**Knowledge, Skills, Abilities** 



* Practical experience designing, building, and supporting ETL/ELT pipelines, data ingestion processes, system integrations, and data feeds
* Working knowledge of Python and SQL for data movement, automation, validation, troubleshooting, and operational support
* Experience with cloud data platforms, Snowflake
* Familiarity with modern data engineering, governance, and observability tools, including Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, Monte Carlo, Immuta, and Atlan
* Understanding of orchestration, APIs, database connectivity, file\-transfer patterns, scheduling, and dependency management
* Familiarity with medallion architecture and core data modeling concepts used to organize and manage data across platform layers
* Understanding of data quality, lineage, cataloging, access control, privacy, and secure handling of sensitive or regulated data
* Experience with version control, collaborative Git workflows, automated testing, and CI/CD practices
* Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to investigate ambiguous data, integration, platform, or tool issues methodically
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams in a hybrid, globally distributed organization
* Experience in wealth management, asset management, financial technology, or a related financial\-services domain is a plus



**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* 5\-10 years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software engineering, platform engineering, or a related technical role
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* Experience working with sensitive or regulated financial data and following secure data\-handling practices is required



**Why Join AssetMark?** 



* Build global data capabilities from AssetMark's Hyderabad Technology Center, an important part of our India GCC
* Work across a broad data engineering ecosystem that includes the data platform, ingestion, integrations, data feeds, MDS support, quality, governance, and observability
* Work with modern data technologies while learning industry best practices through structured mentorship from experienced engineers
* Develop both technical and business domain expertise in the wealth management industry, with clear advancement pathways as you grow
* Collaborate with colleagues in India and the United States on meaningful technology that supports financial advisors and their clients
* Access comprehensive training resources, workshops, and learning materials designed to accelerate your professional development
* Enjoy comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, and a supportive work environment that values your growth
* Opportunity to build your career in a high\-growth company backed by private equity



**Our Commitment** 




 AssetMark values diversity of thought and background and is committed to building an inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including those who are traditionally underrepresented in technology.
 



 Employment is subject to applicable local requirements and successful completion of AssetMark's hiring process.
 



**Build technology that helps financial advisors serve their clients and grow their businesses.**

 Team \& Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)

title: Associate Director , Data Stewardship

**Job Description**
**R419321 Associate. Director , Data Stewardship**
**The Opportunity**
 Join a global biopharma company with a 130\-year legacy and mission to achieve new milestones in healthcare. Be part of technology driven, data\-led organization supporting a diversified portfolio of medicines, vaccines and animal health products. Work alongside passionate teams that use data, analytics and insights to drive decisions, and tackle some of the world’s greatest health threats.
   

  

 Our Technology Centers are globally distributed hubs that enable our digital transformation and business outcomes across IT. They bring together diverse teams to collaborate, share best practices, and deliver solutions that save and improve lives.
   

  

 This role is based at our Hyderabad Tech Center and follows a hybrid working model (3 days per week in the office and 2 days remote). Candidates are expected to reside within a commuting distance of the Hyderabad office.The Associate Director, Technical Product Owner – Automation \& Material Master Stewardship is a high\-impact, hybrid leadership role. It requires a rare blend of deep Material Master Data domain expertise and advanced technical product management capabilities.
   

  

 Operating at the intersection of supply chain operations, enterprise IT, and digital innovation, this individual will own the technical roadmap for our core data creation and maintenance platforms (specifically Syniti / DSP and its complex integrations into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
   

  

 The role's mission is twofold
   

  

* Material Master Domain Leadership \& Tool Ownership Act as the technical and operational authority for the global Material Master data model in our stewardship tools. You will ensure these systems operate with high reliability, comply with rigid data standards, and evolve through structured releases to support complex supply chain and manufacturing activities.
* Process Automation \& Workflow Re\-engineering Partner with Global Data Steward Leads, Quality, and IT teams to systematically transition stewardship activities from manual, high\-touch execution to intelligent, streamlined, and automated workflows.


 As a senior technical leader within the Hyderabad Tech Center, you will leverage local technical talent while maintaining global alignment to drive operational excellence, GxP compliance, and modern automation practices (including generative AI and workflow orchestration).
   

  

**What Will You Do in This Ro** 
 le
   

  

* Material Master Data Domain Governance \& Platform Ownership


 Govern the Material Master Data Model Serve as the technical custodian for the Material Master data structure within our stewardship tools, ensuring a deep understanding of master data dependencies, taxonomy, and downstream impacts on manufacturing and logistics.
   

  

 Own the Tooling Ecosystem Act as the Technical Product Owner for data creation, change management, and validation tooling (such as Syniti/DSP and associated middleware connecting into SAP ECC and SAP S/4HANA).
   

  

 Align Business Logic with Tech Translate complex Material Master requirements (e.g., global vs. local views, Plant/Storage Location parameters, Bill of Materials (BOM) configurations, and regulatory metadata) into precise technical specifications and tool rules.
   

  

 Backlog \& Release Management Lead backlog grooming, sprint planning, feature prioritization, and release roadmaps in close coordination with IT delivery engineers, architecture teams, and global business stewards.
   

  

* Process Re\-Engineering, Simplification \& Automation


 End\-to\-End Material Workflow Optimization Deep\-dive into existing material stewardship processes (such as first\-time material code creation, changes, and plant extensions) to eliminate manual bottlenecks, redundant pre\-checks, and handoff delays.
   

  

 Intelligent Automation Delivery Design, evaluate, and implement automation solutions across the material lifecycle, utilizing business rule engines, automated validation scripts, API integrations, and low\-code orchestration platforms.
   

  

 AI \& GenAI Integration Spearhead the practical adoption of generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and machine learning capabilities to assist data stewards in automated data validation, material request interpretation, anomaly detection, and auto\-generated documentation.
   

  

 Industry Best Practices Benchmark external master data management (MDM) and supply chain automation frameworks to keep our operating model forward\-looking and scalable.
   

  

* Quality, GxP Compliance \& Data Integrity


 Quality \& Validation Partnership Partner closely with Quality Assurance, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), and Regulatory teams to ensure all tooling enhancements, automation bots, and scripts meet strict GxP and audit standards.
   

  

 Automated Data Quality \& Controls Build automated, GxP\-compliant data governance pre\-checks, validation rules, and mandatory approval workflows directly into the tooling UI to enforce data integrity at the moment of entry.
   

  

 Audit Readiness \& Traceability Ensure full lifecycle traceability, change control documentation, and audit trail reliability for all automated and system\-assisted data operations.
   

  

* Global Partnership, Location Synergy \& Team Upskilling


 Bridge IT and Stewardship Operations Serve as the primary technical liaison in Hyderabad, connecting local IT/software product development with global data stewardship leaders and supply chain operations.
   

  

 Drive Change \& Adoption Partner with Global Data Leads and operational managers to design rollout plans, training materials, and change\-management programs for new automated ways of working.
   

  

 Technical Mentorship Foster an automation\-first culture across the Hyderabad stewardship hub, coaching team members on digital tools, prompt engineering, and automated testing practices.
   

  

 What Should You Have
   

  

* Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Data Engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent practical experience).


**Experience**
* 8\+ years of progressive experience in Master Data Management (MDM), Technical Product Ownership, Business Systems Analysis, or Enterprise Data Solutions.
* Strong functional background in SAP Material Master (MM) operations, with a clear understanding of supply chain, procurement, and manufacturing data flows.
* Substantial experience operating in a regulated enterprise environment (pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or medical devices preferred).
* Proven track record of owning enterprise tooling releases and delivering measurable automation or process simplification projects.


**Primary Skills (Must\-Have)**
* Deep Material Master Data Expertise Comprehensive, practical knowledge of the SAP Material Master data structure, fields, views (Basic, Sales, Purchasing, MRP, Plant/Storage, Costing), and how data setups impact downstream physical supply chain execution.
* Tool Ownership \& MDM Platforms Hands\-on technical experience with master data creation and governance platforms, preferably Syniti (DSP) or comparable enterprise MDM/governance suites.
* SAP Master Data Architecture Solid technical and functional knowledge of SAP master data processes (SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA), specifically Material Master and its integration with manufacturing, procurement, and supply chain modules.
* Process Automation \& Digitization Demonstrated success identifying, designing, and rolling out workflow automation, rule engines, RPA, or automated data validation pipelines.
* Modern AI \& GenAI Fluency Practical experience leveraging Generative AI (e.g., Gemini) and digital productivity tools to accelerate data operations, validation logic, and process documentation.
* Agile Product Ownership Expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery methodologies, writing technical user stories, managing sprint roadmaps, and running User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* GxP \& Regulated Environment Compliance Strong understanding of GxP standards, Computer Systems Validation (CSV), data integrity requirements, and regulated change control procedures.
* Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Communication Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge complex business requirements with technical IT engineering across global time zones.

Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
   

  

**What We Look For**

 We are looking for an AI Data Protection Forward Deployed Engineer – Manager to act as the technical owner for client\-facing data protection transformations that sit at the intersection of enterprise platforms, cybersecurity controls, and AI tools. This role is for a hands\-on leader who can move from discovery to design to deployment, embedding closely with clients to architect and implement high\-impact solutions while leading engineering teams and shaping deals. **Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the discovery, architecture, and deployment of AI\-enabled data protection solutions for strategic clients, translating business, privacy, and cybersecurity requirements into scalable technical designs.
* Serve as a forward deployed technical leader, embedding with client stakeholders to break down ambiguous problem statements, make architecture decisions, and drive measurable outcomes in production. External FDE role definitions from EY, Databricks, Palantir, and Deloitte all emphasize this embedded technical ownership model.
* Architect integrations across data protection platforms, AI models, copilots, RAG pipelines, enterprise data estates, and downstream security/policy controls.

* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience designing and deploying enterprise\-grade solutions across cloud and hybrid environments, ideally on Azure, AWS, or GCP. Comparable FDE manager roles consistently require cloud\-native delivery, APIs, and production systems ownership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Why join us**
 Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI\-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI — helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology\-enabled, consulting\-led, and globally delivered.

We provide cutting\-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.
 



  





**What CIBC India Offers:** 




 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):** 




 We are seeking an experienced Application Developer ETL with a strong foundation in modern data engineering practices to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines on the Databricks platform hosted on Azure.
 



 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):** 



* Architect and implement data pipelines following the Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture
* Ingest data from diverse sources including APIs, flat files, binary files, and Databricks\-to\-Databricks transfers using Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS Gen2\)
* Apply data modeling techniques including Data Vault 2\.0 and Kimball Dimensional Modeling
* Implement a Data Quality Framework to enforce data integrity and reliability standards
* Handle complex data scenarios such as SCD Type 2, late\-arriving data, carry\-forward logic, backfill, reprocess, and restatement
* Build ETL control and audit frameworks for lineage, monitoring, and traceability
* Develop and optimize Delta Lake tables leveraging ACID transactions, Z\-ordering, and OPTIMIZE for performance
* Build real\-time data pipelines using Structured Streaming for low\-latency ingestion and processing
* Orchestrate and schedule pipeline workflows using Databricks Workflows (Jobs)
* Tune Spark jobs through query optimization, partitioning strategies, and cluster/compute sizing
* Enforce data security policies including Row\-Level Security (RLS), Column\-Level Security (CLS), and data masking
* Manage data governance and access control using Unity Catalog.



  





**CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:** 



* Partner with data engineering, platform, and architecture teams to design and implement scalable data pipelines aligned to enterprise data architecture standards, supporting ingestion from a broad range of internal and external data sources.
* Collaborate with data modelers, business stakeholders, and domain subject\-matter experts to apply leading data modeling practices, establish data quality standards, and address complex data scenarios including historical tracking, late\-arriving data, backfill, reprocessing, and restatement requirements.
* Work closely with platform operations, governance, and information security teams to optimize data processing performance, orchestrate production workflows, and enforce enterprise controls for lineage, monitoring, traceability, access management, and data security.



  





**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:** 



* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines and controls.



  





**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:** 



* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.



  





**JOB DIMENSIONS:** 



* Individual contributor role focused on designing and delivering scalable data pipeline and processing solutions that support enterprise reporting, analytics, and operational decision\-making.
* Works across multiple data domains and source types; responsible for transforming raw data into reliable, well\-structured, and governed data assets that enable trusted consumption for downstream use.
* Acts as a key partner to engineering, business, governance, and risk stakeholders on data modeling, data quality, lineage, and control requirements to strengthen usability, compliance, and overall data integrity.



  





**Experience:** 
 5\+ years of experience
 



**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):** 



* Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or related field.



  





**Must Have Skills:** 



* 5\+ years of experience as an application developer with the following skills:
* Hands\-on experience with Medallion architecture on Azure (ADLS Gen2\)
* Strong proficiency in PySpark and Databricks SQL
* Deep knowledge of Delta Lake (ACID transactions, Z\-ordering, incremental processing)
* Expertise in Structured Streaming for real\-time pipeline development
* Proficiency with Databricks Workflows (Jobs) for orchestration and scheduling
* Experience with Spark Declarative Pipelines (Lake flow / formerly Delta Live Tables)
* Advanced Spark performance tuning, partitioning, caching, compute sizing
* Deep knowledge of Data Vault 2\.0 and Kimball Dimensional Modeling
* Solid understanding of Unity Catalog for data governance and security
* Expertise in exception handling and data quality enforcement
* Familiarity with Genie Space for natural language data exploration.

 and

 At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.
 



 We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance\-based incentive programs, a family\-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points\-based recognition program.
 



 Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide
 



 We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 As a Senior Business Intelligence Consultant, you will lead the modernization of business reporting and analytics at CIBC, partnering closely with the Analytics Head Office in Toronto and key business stakeholders.
 



  





 This role sits within the business intelligence function and is focused on business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and migration of business\-owned reporting assets and logic to modern cloud\-based environments. You will help transform legacy SAS/SQL reporting into scalable, business\-ready reporting solutions using SQL, Python, and Power BI or Tableau.
 



 In addition to the existing BI responsibilities, this role requires strong experience in Azure Databricks, experience in building data products, and practical use of AI in previous roles to improve reporting quality, productivity, or modernization outcomes.
 



 This is not a backend ETL pipeline engineering role or a source\-system data migration role. The primary focus is on management reporting, dashboard development, ad hoc analysis, reporting logic modernization, business insight delivery, and enabling modern BI capabilities through cloud\-based tools and data products.
 



  





 At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on\-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed:** 



* Reporting \& BI Solution Leadership: Lead the modernization of legacy reporting assets and deliver business\-ready reporting solutions that support decision\-making.
* Own the development and enhancement of dashboards, scorecards, recurring management reports, and ad hoc analyses.
* Deliver reporting solutions that are accurate, scalable, user\-friendly, and aligned to business priorities.
* Business Partnership: Partner closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting needs, define KPIs and metrics, and translate business questions into actionable reporting solutions. • Act as a trusted advisor on reporting design, metric interpretation, and business insight delivery.
* Present findings, reporting logic, and recommendations clearly to business audiences with strong communication and confidence.
* Reporting Migration \& Modernization: Lead the migration of business reporting assets, SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic, and analytical workflows into modern cloud\-based reporting solutions. • Convert legacy reporting code and logic into SQL\- and Python\-based solutions that preserve business meaning and reporting integrity.
* Rationalize, simplify, and modernize legacy reports and reporting processes for improved usability and efficiency.
* Dashboarding \& Analytics: Develop advanced dashboards and business intelligence reports using Power BI or Tableau.
* Use SQL and Python for analysis, reporting logic, reconciliation, validation, and data preparation in support of reporting outcomes.
* Leverage Azure Databricks as part of the modern analytics ecosystem to support scalable BI and reporting use cases.
* Deliver ad hoc analysis and insight generation for business and leadership teams.
* Data Products: Contribute to the design, build, and evolution of data products that enable reusable, trusted, and business\-consumable data assets.
* Ensure data products are aligned with business outcomes, usability standards, and reporting requirements.
* Data Quality, Controls \& Governance: Ensure reporting outputs are accurate, complete, traceable, and aligned to governance standards and controls.
* Document business logic, metric definitions, assumptions, and key transformations as needed.
* Identify and resolve data quality issues that affect reporting integrity.
* Stakeholder \& Team Leadership: Build strong relationships with business partners, analytics teams, and related stakeholders across functions.
* Handle senior stakeholders effectively and demonstrate strong communication, executive presence, and confidence in discussions and presentations.
* Coach and support team members or junior analysts as appropriate, fostering strong reporting and analytical practices.
* Contribute thought leadership on BI/reporting modernization and business value delivery.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to automate repetitive reporting activities and improve reporting workflows.
* Use AI or automation tools where appropriate to support code conversion, reporting quality checks, productivity gains, and insight generation.
* Recommend improvements to reports, dashboards, business processes, data products, and reporting operating models.



  





**Experience:** 



* 10\+ years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, MIS, or business\-facing data roles.
* Strong experience delivering management reporting, dashboards, ad hoc analysis, and KPI\-based reporting.
* Proven experience modernizing or migrating legacy reporting assets, including SAS/SQL\-based reporting logic.
* Strong track record of working directly with business stakeholders to define and deliver reporting solutions.
* Experience leading or significantly contributing to reporting transformation or reporting modernization initiatives.
* Strong experience in Azure Databricks as part of cloud\-based analytics or reporting environments.
* Experience handling stakeholders across business and technology teams with strong communication and confidence.
* Experience building data products that support reporting, analytics, or business decision making.
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools or automation in previous roles for reporting migration, reporting quality assurance, analytics workflows, or productivity improvement.



  





**Who You Are:** 



* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI or Tableau; one of these should be a core strength.
* Deep experience in business reporting, dashboarding, analytics, and stakeholder\-facing insight delivery.
* Strong understanding of KPI development, metric definition, reconciliation, and reporting controls.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, high\-quality reporting solutions.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem\-solving skills.
* Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching, mentoring, or leading workstreams.
* Experience with SAS and legacy reporting environments is strongly preferred.
* Strong experience with Azure Databricks is required. • Experience building data products is highly valued.
* Familiarity with automation and AI\-enabled productivity tools is required, with practical prior usage preferred.



  





**Nice to Have:** 



* Exposure to Azure\-based analytics environments.
* Experience with Databricks in business intelligence and analytics use cases.
* Experience with business reporting migration into cloud\-based reporting platforms.
* Experience with both Power BI and Tableau.
* Financial services or regulated industry reporting experience.



  





**Preferred Candidate Profile:** 



* Senior Business Intelligence consultant.
* Reporting and analytics lead.
* BI developer / BI analyst with strong business engagement.
* MIS / management reporting lead.
* Dashboard and KPI reporting specialist.
* Reporting modernization lead.
* Candidates whose experience is primarily in ETL pipeline development, data ingestion, backend data engineering, cloud infrastructure, or source\-to\-target migration without strong business intelligence and reporting delivery experience may be less aligned to this role.



  





**Privacy:** 




 By proceeding with the creation of a profile and submitting an application in response to this job posting, you acknowledge and agree that your personal data will be collected, used, retained and disclosed by CIBC India and its affiliates, as described in the Candidate Privacy Statement.

 This position will be part of the Master Data Maintenance Team under the Global Sales Enablement team supporting PepsiCo Beverages North America business team.

+ Data\-related discrepancies

* Troubleshoot system errors and ensure resolution within defined SLAs.

* Ensure timely processing of setup requests through SPA inbox.
* Support correct onboarding of new distributors in PepsiCo databases. Ensure proper configuration of account hierarchies and master data

**Qualifications**

**About The Role**
 The SAP Integration Manager is responsible for leading the design, delivery, and governance of enterprise\-wide integrations across SAP and non SAP applications using SAP Process Orchestration (PO) and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) Integration Suite. The role requires deep hands\-on integration expertise, strong architectural thinking, and the ability to modernize integration landscapes using API\-first and event\-driven patterns. Success in this role depends on strong communication, stakeholder management, and the capability to guide global teams toward scalable, reliable, and future\-ready integration solutions.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

 Leads the enterprise integration strategy across SAP PO and SAP BTP Integration Suite, ensuring a smooth transition from traditional middleware to cloud\-first integration architectures.
   

  

* Designs and governs scalable integration patterns using APIs, events, EDI/IDocs, SAP CPI, and REST/OData services.
* Manages end\-to\-end delivery of integration solutions for ERP programs, including SAP S/4HANA transformations and key business\-critical projects.
* Ensures integration solutions adhere to clean\-core, reusable, secure, and modular design principles aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
* Oversees the operations, performance tuning, and lifecycle management of SAP PO (PI/PO), including message monitoring, error handling, and interface optimization.
* Leads the expansion and adoption of SAP BTP Integration Suite—Cloud Integration (CPI), API Management, Event Mesh, and Open Connectors.
* Enables integration modernization by driving API\-first and event\-driven architectural practices across global business functions.
* Works closely with business, application, and technology teams to translate integration requirements into high quality technical designs.
* Manages EDI integrations with internal and external partners, ensuring reliable data exchange and SLA compliance.
* Implements integration standards, naming conventions, documentation, test frameworks, and version\-controlled repository\-based development.
* Provides leadership to integration developers, ensuring skill development, code quality, and consistent technical excellence.

* Guides vendor teams, system integrators, and external partners to ensure high\-quality integration deliveries.
* Communicates integration design concepts in simple business language to global stakeholders and senior leadership.
* Continuously evaluates new SAP BTP innovations, automation tools, and integration technologies to enhance the digital ecosystem.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

 Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
   

  

* 15\-20 years of experience in SAP integration delivery and operations, with strong expertise in both SAP PO (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* Hands\-on experience in building integrations using SAP CPI, API Management, Event Mesh, EDI/IDoc, SOAP/REST services, and cloud connectors.
* Strong experience designing integration architecture for SAP S/4HANA projects in global enterprise environments.
* Good understanding of modern middleware concepts including API\-led integration, event\-driven architecture, microservices, and cloud\-native integration.
* Experience leading teams, managing developer workloads, and reviewing integration deliverables for quality and compliance.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices such as Git\-based repositories, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and artifact versioning for integration artifacts.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work in matrix organizations and collaborate with cross\-functional global teams.

 Product Development, system development, Project Management, Programme Management, Design Thinking, Process Automisation, IT Service Management, Innovation Processes, Innovation, User Experience Design, Change Analyst, Change Management, Digital Transformation, Value Analysis, Change Management, Adoption, Technology Adoption Lifecycle, Stakeholder Relationship Management, Vendor Management, Outstanding Communication, stakeholder engagement, Digital Strategy, Product Solution Architecture, Cyber Security Strategy, Cyber Security, Data Privacy, Portfolio Management, Data Governance, Product Compliance, Media Analytics, advertising, Consumer Engagement, Market Value, Market Chain, Data Driven Practices, Advanced Analytics, Data Analytics, Governance.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**GENERAL FUNCTION**
 We are hiring a
 **Lead Data Engineer** 
 to design and deliver scalable data pipelines and data solutions on our modern data stack, centered on Snowflake on AWS, Snowflake Openflow (Apache NiFi), dbt, PostgreSQL, Python, and SQL. This is a senior hands\-on engineering role responsible for translating business and data requirements into sound technical designs, building and optimizing pipelines, and delivering reliable data products. The role leads Data Operations support and serves as a senior coordination point for India\-based data colleagues, helping organize priorities, remove blockers, and maintain continuity across the broader Data team while working within established reporting lines. A key focus is maturing Data Operations through automated monitoring and proactive support.
   

  

**DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES**
**Data engineering, solution design, and delivery**
* Lead the end\-to\-end design and delivery of scalable data pipelines and data solutions using Snowflake, Snowflake Openflow (Apache NiFi), and dbt.

* Develop in advanced SQL and Python and remain hands\-on through code reviews, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and resolution of complex engineering issues.
* Ensure solutions meet expectations for data quality, security, scalability, maintainability, observability, and cost efficiency.
* Collaborate with architecture, analytics, platform, security, application, and business teams to align designs, data contracts, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
* Maintain clear technical documentation and contribute reusable engineering patterns and standards across the broader Data team.


**Data Operations leadership and team coordination**
* Lead Data Operations support and coordinate priorities, handoffs, and issue resolution across India\-based data colleagues, working within established reporting lines.
* Establish and reinforce engineering practices for source control, peer review, testing, CI/CD, deployment, documentation, and production readiness.
* Mentor colleagues through design and code reviews, promote cross\-training, and help engineers independently deliver and support data solutions.
* Own and mature Data Operations, including support coverage, incident response, escalation paths, runbooks, recovery procedures, and service expectations.
* Drive automated monitoring, alerting, and recovery across Snowflake, Openflow, dbt, databases, and pipeline workloads to reduce manual checks and identify issues proactively.
* Track service health and incident trends, lead root\-cause analysis, and maintain a prioritized plan to improve reliability and operational efficiency.


**EXPERIENCE \& EDUCATION**
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* 10\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience, including at least 2 years leading technical delivery or production operations.

* Strong solution\-design, communication, and technical\-leadership skills, with the ability to guide decisions, mentor engineers, and work across business and technology teams.


**Nice to have**
* Experience working with Snowflake and production data pipelines in AWS environments.
* Hands\-on experience with Apache NiFi or Snowflake Openflow, including reusable flow design, orchestration, error handling, monitoring, and deployment.
* Experience with relational databases including RDS and PostgreSQL
* Experience in financial services or another regulated environment, including auditability, reconciliation, privacy, and production\-control expectations.
* Experience with automated observability, data\-quality, metadata, lineage, or data\-catalog tools.
* Certification in Snowflake, dbt, Apache NiFi, AWS, or data\-management.
